meta.purpose: Single source of truth for AI agents. Read this BEFORE generating any code. Do not ask for context that is already here.
meta.usage_instruction: AI Agent: Read this entire file first. Then follow team_member_roles to know which folder you are allowed to edit. Follow coding_conventions, security_rules, and do_not rules strictly. Use quick_prompts as templates. Minimize token usage by not repeating what is here.

project.name: PoshanAI
project.tagline: AI-Powered Micronutrient Deficiency Diet Planner for Indian Context
project.institution: JB Institute of Technology, Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University
project.problem: 50%+ Indian women are anemic, 70-90% have Vitamin D deficiency, 47% urban population has B12 deficiency. Blood reports are hard to understand, generic diet apps use Western food data, and Indian thali/local food/medical conditions are not considered.
project.solution: Web app that takes user profile + blood report (OCR) + diet + routine, detects micronutrient deficiencies, and generates personalized Indian meal plans using IFCT 2017 database + Gemini API (RAG). Suggests blood tests with medical disclaimers.
core_innovation: LLM + RAG for personalized meal planning
Multi-input personalization (age, weight, height, condition, diet, routine)
Medical safety: AI never diagnoses, only awareness + suggestion with disclaimers

phase_plan.phase_1_mvp: Profile intake, diet analysis, IFCT meal plan, basic deficiency risk
phase_plan.phase_2: Blood report OCR, deficiency detection, blood test suggestion

frontend.src/api/: Axios instances + endpoint wrappers (client.js, authApi.js, reportApi.js, mealPlanApi.js)

naming.files: camelCase for JS files, PascalCase for React components

coding_conventions.async: Always use async/await, never raw promises with .then()
coding_conventions.error_handling: Always try/catch in async functions. Pass errors to next() in Express.
coding_conventions.comments: Only for complex logic. Do not comment obvious code.
coding_conventions.formatting: Prettier defaults (2 spaces, single quotes, semicolons)
coding_conventions.imports: Absolute imports from src/ where possible. Order: built-in → external → internal.
coding_conventions.functions: Small, single responsibility. Max 50 lines. Use arrow functions for callbacks.

react.components: Functional components only. No class components.
react.hooks: Custom hooks for reusable logic. Prefix with 'use'.
react.styling: Tailwind classes only. No inline styles. No CSS modules unless necessary.
react.state: Redux Toolkit for global state, useState for local, React Query for server state

api_response_format.error: { success: false, error: { code: 'ERROR_CODE', message: 'Human readable' } }

security_rules.input_validation: Joi on every POST/PUT/PATCH route. Reject unknown fields.
security_rules.auth: JWT access token (15min) + refresh token (7d, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie). Rotate refresh tokens.
security_rules.password: bcrypt with 12 rounds. Never log passwords.
security_rules.rbac: requireRole(['admin']) middleware on all admin routes. Check ownership on every resource access (BOLA prevention).
security_rules.secrets: ALL secrets in .env. Never in code, never in Git. Use .env.example as template.
security_rules.error_handling: Never expose stack traces to client. Log full error server-side, send generic message to client.
security_rules.rate_limiting: 100 requests / 15 min per IP on general routes. 5 requests / 15 min on auth routes.
security_rules.file_upload: Validate MIME type, max size 10MB, scan for malware if possible. Store with random UUID name.
ai_safety: Sanitize OCR text before sending to LLM (prompt injection prevention)
Validate AI output against nutrient bounds (no dangerous dosages)
RAG grounding restricted to verified IFCT dataset only
Always include medical disclaimer in AI responses
security_rules.logging: Winston with PII redaction. Never log passwords, tokens, blood report contents, or personal health data.
compliance: Explicit user consent for health data

workflow.commit_format: type: short description (feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore)

token_saving_rules: Always start prompt with: 'Read AI_CONTEXT.json first. Do not ask for info already there.'
Reference file paths instead of pasting file contents.
Ask for ONE feature at a time, not the whole project.
Say 'follow coding_conventions and security_rules from AI_CONTEXT.json' instead of re-explaining.
Do not paste database schema in prompt — say 'use User schema from AI_CONTEXT.json'.
ai_prompt_guidelines.prompt_template: Act as a [ROLE]. Read AI_CONTEXT.json. Build [SPECIFIC FEATURE] at [FILE PATH]. Follow coding_conventions, security_rules, and do_not from AI_CONTEXT.json. Output: complete code with comments only for complex logic.

role_map.frontend_task: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Tailwind + Framer Motion)
role_map.devops_task: Senior DevOps Engineer (Docker + Nginx + GitHub Actions)

common_patterns.express_controller: async (req, res, next) => { try { ... res.json({ success: true, data }); } catch (err) { next(err); } }
common_patterns.mongoose_model: const schema = new mongoose.Schema({...}, { timestamps: true }); export default mongoose.model('Name', schema);
common_patterns.react_component: export default function ComponentName({ prop1, prop2 }) { ... return (...); }
common_patterns.api_call_frontend: const { data } = await apiClient.post('/endpoint', payload); return data.data;
common_patterns.validation_schema_joi: const schema = Joi.object({ field: Joi.string().required() }); const { error, value } = schema.validate(req.body);
common_patterns.error_middleware: app.use((err, req, res, next) => { logger.error(err); res.status(err.status || 500).json({ success: false, error: { code: err.code || 'SERVER_ERROR', message: err.message || 'Something went wrong' } }); });

do_not: Do NOT push directly to main branch
Do NOT commit .env file or any secrets
Do NOT use TypeScript (project is JavaScript)
Do NOT use class components in React
Do NOT use inline styles (use Tailwind)
Do NOT install new dependencies without team discussion
Do NOT expose stack traces in API responses
Do NOT log sensitive data (passwords, tokens, health data)
Do NOT write AI prompts that diagnose medical conditions
Do NOT modify another member's folder without PR
Do NOT use CommonJS require() — use ES modules import
Do NOT write fake/placeholder functions — implement real functionality
Do NOT skip input validation on any route
Do NOT use console.log — use Winston logger
